planets.name: WASP-77 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-77 A with a 1.36-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-77 A b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-77 A. Its orbit and size follow Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
